# Address-book documentation separates contact data, directory storage and UI entry points

The three accepted source guides distinguish contact/vCard property APIs, directory/manager/storage types and user-interface entry points. Their SQLiteDirectory to AddrBookDirectory and CardDAVDirectory to SQLiteDirectory relationships match the checked class declarations. Later directory constants/anchor edits remain separate from the initial documentation. Use these pages to locate the relevant layer; read its implementation before extending provider or UI behavior. Missing required Bug comment 14 keeps this landing a zero-credit partial.

Scope: Address Book architecture documentation.
